climate.method: Location-month means; equal-weight aggregation across matched locations. Descriptive only.
climate.note: Temperature anomalies are relative to each location’s own calendar-month average over the available dataset. Year-over-year changes use only location-month pairs observed in both adjacent years. Precipitation is mean daily precipitation per location-month, not a monthly accumulated total. These short-record summaries are not climate normals or evidence of climate change.

forecasts.scaling_note: StandardScaler is applied to Ridge only; tree-based models use unscaled features.

air_quality.note: OpenAQ v3 observations matched with weather data: 68,172 matched city-days (82.59% of air-quality city-days), across 143 city-country pairs. Six pollutants analyzed. Correlations are observational, not causal. Within-city Pearson correlations remove city means but do not adjust for seasonality, time trends or serial dependence. Gas pollutant units are kept separate.
air_quality.method: Within-city Pearson; pooled Pearson and Spearman retained in CSV.
